# News Release


10/7/2026


SOUTH BOW ANNOUNCES TIMING OF THIRD-QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND CONFERENCE CALL AND WEBCAST


CALGARY, Alta. – Oct. 7, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow or the Company) will release its third-quarter 2026 financial and operational results after the close of markets on Nov. 4, 2026.
